SAM.name: Samurai Army
SAM.weakness: Less effective when scattered or attacked from multiple directions.

SHI.name: Shinobi Army
SHI.weakness: Lower sustained DEF and reduced power in prolonged frontal engagements.

KNI.name: Knight Army
KNI.weakness: Lower mobility without cavalry; vulnerable to being surrounded.

DRG.name: Dragon Host
DRG.weakness: Anti-air zones, enclosed maps, ritual bindings, limited objective capture.

RIT.name: Ritual Cult
RIT.weakness: Specialist teams only; cannot unlock extra commanders or elites.

ARC.name: Cobalt Conclave
ARC.identity: Hired battle-magi: ranged suppression and wards
ARC.weakness: Sworn company, not an army: brittle in melee and unable to lead a host of its own.

WIT.name: Thorn Coven
WIT.identity: Hexers who rot morale and choke ground
WIT.weakness: Sworn company, not an army: slow, few in number, and helpless once its ground is cleared.

ROG.name: Cutpurse Court
ROG.identity: Back-alley knives: flank strikes and withdrawal
ROG.weakness: Sworn company, not an army: cannot hold a line and folds under sustained pressure.

STP.name: Windmarch Host
STP.weakness: Sworn company, not an army: loses its edge in close country and inside walls.

DUN.name: Dunewake Compact
DUN.identity: Glass-road caravaneers: endurance and shifting ground
DUN.weakness: Sworn company, not an army: light armour and no answer to massed cavalry.

ANG.name: Choir Militant
ANG.identity: Winged executors of a judgement nobody remembers issuing
ANG.weakness: Bound to its orders: slow to change target once committed, and its wings are easy meat for massed shot.

DEM.name: Ashpit Legion
DEM.identity: Demons who pay for every blow in their own substance
DEM.weakness: Burns itself to strike hard: a legion that fights long enough loses to its own price.

CHR.name: Spiral Warband
CHR.identity: Chaos riders under a broken banner, fast and unpredictable
CHR.weakness: No line, no discipline, no second plan; it wins in the first three rounds or not at all.

DMG.name: Half-Born Host
DMG.identity: Demigods: mortal frames carrying more than a mortal share
DMG.weakness: Few in number and impossible to replace; every loss is permanent to the host.

WEN.name: Winter Famine
WEN.identity: Antlered hungers that slow a field to a crawl and eat it
WEN.weakness: Starving by nature: brittle, thin-boned, and undone by anything that closes fast and hits once.

SAS.name: Ridge Kin
SAS.identity: Forest hominids: heavy hands, long ground, no formation at all
SAS.weakness: Refuses open ground and cannot be made to hold a line it did not choose.

FMC.name: Formic Swarm
FMC.identity: One will in many bodies, from drones to standing myrmidons
FMC.weakness: Everything it does runs through the Empress; cut her out and the swarm is only insects.
